sections.heading: Loss details
fields: Maple Harbor Community College parking lot, Maple Harbor, OR
Single-vehicle collision with a fixed object

sections.heading: What happened (in your own words)
sections.paragraph: I was backing out of a parking space and hit a concrete post at the end of the row that I did not see. The back of the car hit the post on the passenger side corner. The rear bumper is pushed in and cracked at the corner and the trunk lid has a dent near the bottom edge. The trunk still opens. Nobody else was involved and nobody was hurt.

sections.heading: Damage to your vehicle
fields: Rear bumper pushed in and cracked at the right corner; dent near the bottom edge of the trunk lid.
Did the vehicle have damage before this incident that has not been repaired?
